admission_cell_overview.description: Acts as an interface between students and the Institute, guiding them on career options and admission guidelines to secure a seat in their course of choice.
services: Assistance in choosing courses as per educational background
Academic assessment as per eligibility criteria for particular courses
Guidance for students conditionally accepted or on academic/disciplinary probation
Discussion on various career options for particular course(s)
Personal counseling to individual students and small groups
Sharing fee and document details required to register for a seat
Conducting informational programs and seminars on admission requirements, policies, and procedures
